user.title: Connect to SecuritySpy
user.description: Enter the address of the Mac running SecuritySpy and a SecuritySpy web server account to connect with.

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the Mac running SecuritySpy, on its own - no http://, no port and no path.
data_description.port: SecuritySpy's web server port. Find it in SecuritySpy under Preferences > Web Server.
data_description.username: A SecuritySpy web server account. Home Assistant only creates the entities this account is permitted to use.
data_description.password: The password for that SecuritySpy account.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach SecuritySpy at that address. Check that the Mac is awake, that the host and port are right, and that SecuritySpy's web server is turned on under Preferences > Web Server.
error.invalid_auth: SecuritySpy rejected that username or password. Check the account under Preferences > Web Server > Accounts, then enter it again.
error.unsupported_version: That SecuritySpy version is too old for this integration, or it did not answer in a format this integration understands. Update SecuritySpy to version 6.0 or later and try again.
error.invalid_host: That host or account cannot be used. Enter the host on its own - no http://, no port and no path - and use an account whose username has no colon and whose username and password contain no non-Western characters.
error.no_server_uuid: That server did not report a unique ID, which this integration needs to tell your servers apart permanently. Update SecuritySpy to the latest version and try again.
error.unknown: SecuritySpy answered with an error this integration does not recognise. Check SecuritySpy's own log under Window > Log, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This SecuritySpy server is already set up in Home Assistant. Its unique ID matches an existing entry, so it has been reached at a different address.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach SecuritySpy. Check that the Mac is awake and that SecuritySpy's web server is turned on.

invalid_auth.message: SecuritySpy rejected the stored username or password. Enter the account details again.

unsupported_version.message: This SecuritySpy version is too old for this integration. Update SecuritySpy to version 6.0 or later.

invalid_stored_data.message: The saved connection details for this SecuritySpy server cannot be used. Remove the integration and add it again.

unknown.message: SecuritySpy answered with an error this integration does not recognise. Check SecuritySpy's own log under Window > Log.
